name: Zoho Cliq
description: Native Zoho Cliq channel for OpenClaw — reply to DMs and channel @mentions as a bot, with streaming previews, cards, and message actions.

enabled.label: Channel enabled (set false to keep the config but stop the channel)

accounts.label: Additional named accounts (each overrides the top-level section)

refreshToken.label: User-context OAuth refresh token (required for channel posts / edits)

selfSenderIds.label: Bot sender ids to ignore (self / other bots)

replyToMode.label: Reply-to metadata mode (Cliq cannot render reply quotes; off = none, all = carry inbound id for correlation)

replyToModeByChatType.label: Per-chat-type reply-to mode override (direct / group / channel)

groups.label: Per-group config (keyed by channel unique name)

streaming.label: Streaming preview mode (mode: off | partial | block | progress; unset or legacy preview:on resolves to partial; preview:off resolves to off; explicit mode wins over legacy preview)

thinking.label: Instant acknowledgement (default: animated dots placeholder; set mode or animate to "off" to disable)

welcome.label: Welcome message on subscribe (greeting DM on first contact)

pairing.label: Pairing-approval card (post an Approve/Deny card to the bot owner when dmPolicy is pairing)

oauthBase.label: OAuth base URL (data center — defaults to EU https://accounts.zoho.eu)

apiBase.label: Cliq API base URL (data center — defaults to EU https://cliq.zoho.eu)

apiVersion.label: REST API generation per family — string "v2"/"v3" (global override) OR object { dmPost?, channelPost?, channelCard?, delete? }. dmPost defaults to v3 (returns message id → thinking placeholder + DM live-edit); the other families default to v2. Leave unset for the built-in per-family defaults.
